tasks.name: gpt_downgrade_village
tasks.prompt: A hilarious detailed 2D anime illustration set in a bustling medieval fantasy village square with cobblestone paths, timber-framed cottages, a distant windmill, market stalls, and a crowd of shocked villagers holding pitchforks and lanterns staring in disbelief. In the foreground, the majestic pure-white dragon girl from the reference image (white dragon horns, large white wings, scaly white tail, white slit dress with black trim) is squatting clumsily in a mud puddle with a vacant, silly, derpy drooling expression, poking the dirt with a twig where '1+1=3' is scribbled. Beside her, the little blue cloud with eyes (Sora) looks facepalming and sweating awkwardly. Rich intricate background, dramatic comedic contrast, vibrant anime art style.

tasks.name: qwen_kimi_square_dance
tasks.prompt: A lively, detailed 2D anime illustration set in a bustling Chinese neon night plaza with glowing shop signs, street food stalls, a lit fountain, big portable speakers, and cheering elderly aunties dancing in the background. In the foreground, the dignified blue-purple haired lady from the first reference image in her Chinese ink-wash embroidered dress and beret is striking a confident square-dance pose holding her folding fan high. Beside her, the shy timid girl from the second reference image with her rainbow prism hairpin and piano-key skirt is sweating nervously, awkwardly playing her silver flute as dance music accompaniment. Rich colorful night plaza background, festive lighting, comedic anime scene.
